sources.title: Ecuador declares war on armed gangs after TV station attacked on air

stances_toward.note: On 9 January 2024, after an armed attack on a live TV station and the escape of Los Choneros leader Fito, Noboa declared an internal armed conflict against organised crime; BBC reports it as a war on armed gangs. Adversary in the mortal sense: the declared aim is the gangs' defeat, not deterrence (C). Bond none is our reading. The gangs' own view is not in this card. Gaps: the Los Lobos designation and the US terrorist listing dates are not verified in this pass.
